verdict.rationale: The skill runs inside the user's own agent and holds no data in a hosted service. Its deliverables are open-format files the user keeps: production-ready SVG logos, rendered PNGs, and a favicon/app-icon/web-manifest set. The skill itself uses the open Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md), so it works in any agent that supports skills, which leaves little lock-in. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of where all generated artifacts and intermediate work (briefs, concepts, guidelines) are stored and in what formats, and independent or hands-on confirmation of portability.
